shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' pages/index.tsx; sed -n '1,240p' pages/about.tsx; sed -n '1,240p' pages/_app.tsx; sed -n '1,240p' pages/_document.tsx; sed -n '1,240p' package.json; sed -n '1,240p' next.config.ts; sed -n '1,260p' tsconfig.json; git diff -- package.json; git diff --stat"
/bin/bash -lc "rg --files app pages 2>/dev/null | sort; sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx; sed -n '1,200p' app/page.tsx; sed -n '1,220p' app/about/page.tsx; git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short; git diff -- app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/about/page.tsx pages tsconfig.json; sed -n '1,260p' tsconfig.json; if [ -f next-env.d.ts ]; then sed -n '1,80p' next-env.d.ts; fi; find app -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'GET / -> %{http_code}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:3000/ curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'GET /about -> %{http_code}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:3000/about curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'GET /contact -> %{http_code}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:3000/contact curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | rg -o ']*>|[''^<]*|]*>|[''^<]*'"' curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3000/about | rg -o ']*>|[''^<]*|]*>|[''^<]*'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "rmdir pages
git status --short
git diff --check
git diff --stat
sed -n '1,120p' .gitignore
sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "npx tsc --noEmit
if [ -d pages ]; then exit 1; fi
rg -n \"next/(head|router|document|app)|<a\\s\" app && exit 1 || true
rg --files app | sort
git diff --check"

/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short
nl -ba app/layout.tsx
nl -ba app/page.tsx
nl -ba app/about/page.tsx
nl -ba .gitignore
nl -ba tsconfig.json | tail -n 8'
